title: resources.json: the resource records every adapter gives, written by the supervisor each tick (mm resources)

time.description: when the supervisor wrote the file (epoch seconds)

resources.description: the records in order (the pool, its runners, the services, ...). A reader reads at most 1000 (RECORDS_MAX): the first 999 and one UNKNOWN record that counts the ones left out

word.description: a lower-case word: a letter, then up to 31 letters, digits, - or _

record.description: one resource. A reader ignores fields it does not know; a new optional field keeps schema_version 1

resource.description: the kind of resource (machine, pool, runner, service, ...); the core never branches on it

id.description: from the profile, or cleaned outside text; a reader shows its first 120 characters

parent.description: optional: the id of the record this one belongs to (shown only); a reader shows its first 120 characters

time.description: when the supervisor wrote the record; set by the supervisor, so an adapter's output leaves it out (a reader reads a missing time as no record time)

read_time.description: when the resource was last read; null: never read

stale_after_s.description: the writer's limit on now - read_time, from its own setting; null: no read rule

state.description: null: the resource has no thresholds

why.description: a reader shows the row's why (with its own reasons first) cut to 200 characters

values.description: shown in order; a reader reads the first 64 entries (VALUES_MAX)

key.description: not one of the row's own keys; a later duplicate is ignored

value.description: a reader shows a string's first 120 characters
